g.text: FIC-1031 C-101 REFLUX FLOW (CASCADE FROM TIC-1030)
24 VDC loop powered from I/O card (2-wire)
4-20 mA from AO card, HART; positioner loop-powered
1. Cable FC- = field (branch) cable 1 pair 1.5 mm2 screened, IS blue sheath; multicore 12/24 pair, armoured, overall + individual screens; screens earthed at FAR-100 IS earth bar only.
2. Terminal numbers, JB, multicore, cabinet and card/channel assignments from CFU-000-IC-IOL-001 (data/io_list.json) - final at detailed design.
3. Positioner fail action: air failure -> valve OPEN (FO, reflux to column top on air loss).
4. FIC-1031 in CAS from TIC-1030; on TIC bad PV the FIC sheds to AUTO at last SP (bumpless).
5. Power: AI/AO cards 24 VDC from redundant cabinet PSUs fed by UPS-101A/B (UDB-101A/B).
